semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Mitsubishi Chemical Advanced Materials produces high-performance thermoplastic materials that can be utilized in semiconductor packaging and other applications.
summary: Mitsubishi Chemical Advanced Materials is a global manufacturer of high-performance thermoplastic materials, offering semi-finished products and finished parts. Their specialty engineering thermoplastics and composites are designed for superior performance in various applications, including those relevant to the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Global: The company operates in 21 countries with a significant workforce of over 2700 employees.
